title: Writing Samples
text: These are a few pieces of mathematical write ups that I am particularly happy with and which could possibly act as expository stuff regardless of their primary purpose. A more complete list of my work, including slides and other projects can be found in my detailed CV. I plan to create a “Research” page when I have original research work to share, but for now this page is a collection of my expository writings and reports from various projects and seminars.

title: Writing Samples
section: Linear Wave Equations on Schwarzschild–de Sitter Spacetimes
text:
Linear Wave Equations on Schwarzschild–de Sitter Spacetimes




This thesis studies linear wave equations on Schwarzschild–de Sitter spacetimes using spectral theory and microlocal analysis. It develops the geometric and analytic framework behind wave propagation on black-hole backgrounds, with particular attention to radial point estimates and Fredholm theory.
Read the thesis

title: Writing Samples
text:
Results in Harmonic Analysis




This write-up begins with classical geometric and analytic results such as the Loomis–Whitney, isoperimetric, Sobolev, and Hardy–Littlewood–Sobolev inequalities, before moving to oscillatory integrals and geometric constraints. The main part studies the failure of certain \(L^p\) estimates for oscillatory convolution operators through Fefferman’s counterexample.
Read the report

title: Writing Samples
section: Spectral Theorem for Self-Adjoint and Unitary Operators
text:
Spectral Theorem for Self-Adjoint and Unitary Operators




This report develops the basic theory of self-adjoint and unitary operators in functional analysis and proves their spectral theorems, using functional calculus and the Cayley transform as central tools.
Read the report

title: Writing Samples
section: Representation of Finite and Compact Groups
text:
Representation of Finite and Compact Groups




Poster from my undergraduate research project on representation theory of finite and compact groups. The project began with representations of finite groups and continued through Haar measure, compact groups, and the Peter–Weyl theorem, culminating in a proof of versions of the Peter–Weyl theorem.
View the poster

title: Writing Samples
text:
Wasserstein Stability for Lipschitz Functions




Handwritten notes prepared for a seminar on David Cohen-Steiner’s work on stability in persistent homology. The talk introduced triangulations, Lipschitz functions, persistence diagrams, and the ideas underlying Wasserstein stability for Lipschitz functions.
View the handwritten notes

title: Interests
text:
Outside of mathematics, I have quite a few interests that I pursue in my free time. I absolutely love watching and playing football. I’ve been watching Real Madrid since 2010 and try my best not to miss a single match. Below is an image I took inside the Santiago Bernabéu stadium during a visit in 2025 where they played Girona and I got to witness Modric’s last goal for the club.



I am a HUGE foodie and absolutely love trying out new cuisines and dishes. I also enjoy cooking and experimenting with recipes in my kitchen. Below are some images of foods that I’ve tried and enjoyed during my travels.






If you’re ever in Paris, I highly recommend getting wine or beer drunk by the Seine. It’s the perfect spot to go on romantic dates or just hang out with your friends. My favourite spot in particular is Quai Saint-Bernard, which is a small quay on the right bank of the Seine. You find lots of people dancing at night and playing music. Just a few minutes walk away is my favourite pub O’Jasons, which has the best Guiness in Paris. The picture below is from inside the pub with my friend Camil and all the bartenders who are absolutely adorable (I request you to ignore the stains in my shirt, I spilled a lot of alcohol while dancing that night).




Also highly recommend visiting Provins, a small town just an hour and half away from Paris. It’s a cute little town with plenty of medieval architecture and a lot of history. It’s a great place to go for a day trip and just relax.



Finally, I am a huge fan of anime and manga. I don’t watch as much as I used to back in 2020, but I still keep up with new seasons/chapters of my favourite series. It’s hard to pick a favourite anime, so I am attaching my MyAnimeList profile if you want to check out my list of favourite animes, mangas and characters or just add me as a friend there. I also have Instagram and Youtube channels where I post anime edits (I haven’t posted anything in years but will start again soon) which you could check out if you’d like.
